ContentSearch.placeholder: Search the text of this item
ContentSearch.about: Searches with the provider's search service (IIIF Content Search {version}).
ContentSearch.truncated: Stopped at the first {count} hits. Add a word to narrow the search.
ContentSearch.failed: The search failed. The provider's service did not answer, or does not accept requests from the browser.
ContentSearch.scopeLocal: Annotations and captions in this viewer
ContentSearch.aboutLocal: Searches the annotations loaded in this viewer (annotations of the item, and results of text recognition etc. from the Inference tab), and the caption and transcript files of the item (WebVTT and plain text). Click a caption match to play from that time. Case and full/half width are ignored.
ContentSearch.aboutScene: Searches the titles and texts of the annotations in this 3D scene. Click a hit to fly to that annotation. Case and full/half width are ignored.
ContentSearch.missedPages: {count} annotation pages or caption files could not be loaded and were not searched.
